documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: An earlier inquiry from our consulting operations team requested discovery about unclear ownership. The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's operational friction is related to unclear ownership and contradictory project information, as stated in the customer note: 'An earlier inquiry from our consulting operations team requested discovery about unclear ownership. The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement.' This creates uncertainty about the project's direction and integration requirements.

claims.quote: An earlier inquiry from our consulting operations team requested discovery about unclear ownership.
The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement.

raw_proposal.draft: We understand that your team has encountered uncertainty regarding ownership and project status, as noted in your recent communication. To move forward effectively, we would like to clarify the current project requirements and ensure alignment with the owner's expectations. Could you please confirm the current status of the project and the specific integration requirements you are considering?
questions: Can you confirm the current project status and whether it is still active?
Could you clarify the owner's position on the integration requirements?
Are there any specific concerns or disagreements that need to be resolved before proceeding?
uncertainties: The project status is unclear (paused or active).
There is a disagreement about the integration requirements between the owner and consulting operations.
